-- mini tetris -- workshop build
cols=10
rows=16
cell=6
ox=6
oy=14
das_delay=6
das_arr=3
soft_arr=2
lock_delay=8
lock_max=4
score_tbl={100,300,500,800}

function build_rots()
 pi={{n=4,c={{0,1},{1,1},{2,1},{3,1}},p=12},
     {n=2,c={{0,0},{1,0},{0,1},{1,1}},p=10},
     {n=3,c={{1,0},{0,1},{1,1},{2,1}},p=14},
     {n=3,c={{1,0},{2,0},{0,1},{1,1}},p=11},
     {n=3,c={{0,0},{1,0},{1,1},{2,1}},p=8},
     {n=3,c={{0,0},{0,1},{1,1},{2,1}},p=13},
     {n=3,c={{2,0},{0,1},{1,1},{2,1}},p=9}}
 rots={}
 for i=1,7 do
  local n=pi[i].n
  local w={}
  for m=1,4 do
   w[m]={pi[i].c[m][1],pi[i].c[m][2]}
  end
  local set={}
  for k=1,4 do
   local t={}
   for m=1,4 do
    t[m]={w[m][1],w[m][2]}
   end
   set[k]=t
   for m=1,4 do
    local wx=w[m][1]
    local wy=w[m][2]
    w[m][1]=n-1-wy
    w[m][2]=wx
   end
  end
  rots[i]=set
 end
end

function pick()
 if #bag==0 then
  bag={1,2,3,4,5,6,7}
  for i=7,2,-1 do
   local j=flr(rnd(i))+1
   local t=bag[i]
   bag[i]=bag[j]
   bag[j]=t
  end
 end
 local p=bag[#bag]
 deli(bag,#bag)
 return p
end

function fits(t,tx,ty,tr)
 local cs=rots[t][tr+1]
 for m=1,4 do
  local x=tx+cs[m][1]
  local y=ty+cs[m][2]
  if x<0 or x>=cols or y>=rows then
   return false
  end
  if y>=0 and board[y*cols+x]!=0 then
   return false
  end
 end
 return true
end

function clear_lines()
 local n=0
 local r=rows-1
 while r>=0 do
  local full=true
  for c=0,cols-1 do
   if board[r*cols+c]==0 then
    full=false
    break
   end
  end
  if full then
   for rr=r,1,-1 do
    for c=0,cols-1 do
     board[rr*cols+c]=board[(rr-1)*cols+c]
    end
   end
   for c=0,cols-1 do
    board[c]=0
   end
   n+=1
  else
   r-=1
  end
 end
 return n
end

function grav_iv()
 return max(5,28-(level-1)*3)
end

function touch_lock()
 if lock_resets<lock_max then
  lock_t=0
  lock_resets+=1
 end
end

function try_move(d)
 if fits(cur,px+d,py,rot) then
  px+=d
  return true
 end
 return false
end

function try_rot()
 local nr=(rot+1)%4
 local kx={0,-1,1,2,-2,0,0}
 local ky={0,0,0,0,0,-1,-1}
 for k=1,7 do
  if fits(cur,px+kx[k],py+ky[k],nr) then
   rot=nr
   px+=kx[k]
   py+=ky[k]
   return true
  end
 end
 return false
end

function ghost_y()
 local y=py
 while fits(cur,px,y+1,rot) do
  y+=1
 end
 return y
end

function game_over()
 state="over"
 music(-1,200)
 sfx(-1,3)
 sfx(4,3)
end

function spawn()
 cur=next_p
 next_p=pick()
 rot=0
 px=flr((cols-pi[cur].n)/2)
 py=0
 grav_t=0
 lock_t=0
 lock_resets=0
 soft_t=soft_arr
 prev_sd=false
 das_dir=0
 das_t=das_delay
 if not fits(cur,px,py,rot) then
  game_over()
 end
end

function lock_piece()
 local cs=rots[cur][rot+1]
 local col=pi[cur].p
 local above=false
 for m=1,4 do
  local x=px+cs[m][1]
  local y=py+cs[m][2]
  if y<0 then
   above=true
  else
   board[y*cols+x]=col
  end
 end
 local n=clear_lines()
 if n>0 then
  sfx(0,3)
  lines+=n
  score=min(score+score_tbl[min(n,4)]*level,999999)
  level=min(1+flr(lines/10),12)
 end
 if above then
  game_over()
 else
  spawn()
 end
end

function reset()
 for i=0,cols*rows-1 do
  board[i]=0
 end
 score=0
 lines=0
 level=1
 bag={}
 next_p=pick()
 spawn()
 state="play"
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(0,200,7)
end

function update_play(op,xp)
 local l=btn(0)
 local r=btn(1)
 local dir=0
 if l and not r then
  dir=-1
 elseif r and not l then
  dir=1
 end
 if dir!=das_dir then
  das_dir=dir
  das_t=das_delay
  if dir!=0 then
   if try_move(dir) then
    sfx(16,3)
    touch_lock()
   end
  end
 elseif dir!=0 then
  das_t-=1
  if das_t<=0 then
   das_t=das_arr
   if try_move(dir) then
    sfx(16,3)
    touch_lock()
   end
  end
 end
 local sd=btn(3)
 local fell=false
 if sd then
  local step=not prev_sd
  if step then
   soft_t=soft_arr
  else
   soft_t-=1
   if soft_t<=0 then
    step=true
    soft_t=soft_arr
   end
  end
  if step and fits(cur,px,py+1,rot) then
   py+=1
   fell=true
   grav_t=0
   score=min(score+1,999999)
  end
 end
 prev_sd=sd
 if op then
  if try_rot() then
   sfx(17,3)
   touch_lock()
  end
 end
 if xp then
  local d=0
  while fits(cur,px,py+1,rot) do
   py+=1
   d+=1
  end
  if d>0 then
   score=min(score+d*2,999999)
  end
  lock_piece()
  return
 end
 if not fell then
  grav_t+=1
  if grav_t>=grav_iv() then
   grav_t=0
   if fits(cur,px,py+1,rot) then
    py+=1
   end
  end
 end
 if fits(cur,px,py+1,rot) then
  lock_t=0
  lock_resets=0
 else
  lock_t+=1
  if lock_t>=(sd and 3 or lock_delay) then
   lock_piece()
  end
 end
end

function _init()
 build_rots()
 board={}
 for i=0,cols*rows-1 do
  board[i]=0
 end
 score=0
 lines=0
 level=1
 bag={}
 next_p=1
 cur=1
 rot=0
 px=4
 py=0
 grav_t=0
 lock_t=0
 lock_resets=0
 soft_t=soft_arr
 prev_sd=false
 das_dir=0
 das_t=das_delay
 title_t=0
 state="title"
 prev_o=btn(4)
 prev_x=btn(5)
 music(0,200,7)
end

function _update()
 local o_now=btn(4)
 local x_now=btn(5)
 local op=o_now and not prev_o
 local xp=x_now and not prev_x
 prev_o=o_now
 prev_x=x_now
 if state=="title" then
  title_t+=1
  if op then
   reset()
  end
 elseif state=="play" then
  update_play(op,xp)
 else
  if op then
   reset()
  elseif xp then
   state="title"
   title_t=0
   sfx(-1,3)
   music(0,200,7)
  end
 end
end

function draw_cell(gx,gy,c)
 local x=ox+gx*cell
 local y=oy+gy*cell
 rectfill(x,y,x+cell-2,y+cell-2,c)
end

function draw_field()
 rect(4,12,67,111,5)
 for r=0,rows-1 do
  for c=0,cols-1 do
   local v=board[r*cols+c]
   if v!=0 then
    draw_cell(c,r,v)
   end
  end
 end
end

function draw_piece()
 local cs=rots[cur][rot+1]
 local gy=ghost_y()
 if gy>py then
  for m=1,4 do
   local cx=px+cs[m][1]
   local cy=gy+cs[m][2]
   if cy>=0 then
    local x=ox+cx*cell
    local y=oy+cy*cell
    rect(x,y,x+cell-2,y+cell-2,5)
   end
  end
 end
 for m=1,4 do
  local cx=px+cs[m][1]
  local cy=py+cs[m][2]
  if cy>=0 then
   draw_cell(cx,cy,pi[cur].p)
  end
 end
end

function draw_hud()
 print("next",76,16,6)
 rect(72,24,124,52,5)
 local cs=rots[next_p][1]
 local n=pi[next_p].n
 local nx=98-n*2
 for m=1,4 do
  local x=nx+cs[m][1]*4
  local y=34+cs[m][2]*4
  rectfill(x,y,x+2,y+2,pi[next_p].p)
 end
 print("score",74,60,6)
 print(score,74,68,7)
 print("lines",74,78,6)
 print(lines,74,86,7)
 print("level",74,96,6)
 print(level,74,104,7)
end

function _draw()
 cls(0)
 if state=="title" then
  rect(4,4,123,123,1)
  print("mini tetris",42,20,7)
  rectfill(36,34,43,41,12)
  rectfill(44,34,51,41,10)
  rectfill(52,34,59,41,11)
  rectfill(60,34,67,41,8)
  print("o  rotate",46,56,6)
  print("x  hard drop",38,64,6)
  print("< > move",48,72,6)
  print("v  soft drop",38,80,6)
  if flr(title_t/16)%2==0 then
   print("press o to start",30,100,10)
  end
 elseif state=="play" then
  draw_field()
  draw_piece()
  draw_hud()
  print("o rot  x drop",4,118,6)
 else
  draw_field()
  rectfill(14,40,113,88,0)
  rect(14,40,113,88,8)
  print("game over",46,44,8)
  print("score "..score,34,56,7)
  print("lines "..lines,34,63,7)
  print("o restart",40,72,10)
  print("x title",40,80,10)
 end
end
title: 迷你俄罗斯方块 Mini Tetris

design.core_action: 左右移动/旋转/软降调整下落块，X 硬降把方块落定
design.goal: 消行得分并升级（每 10 行一级），尽可能存活更久
design.risk: 堆积到出生点即失败；级别越高重力越快
design.controls: 标题 O 开始；游玩 左右移动(首按立即,长按200ms后每100ms重复) 下软降(首按当帧落一格,之后每67ms一格) O 旋转(严格单次) X 硬降(严格单次)；结束 O 重开 X 回标题
design.scenes: title / play / over，over 显示最终堆叠与分数，O 重开、X 回标题
design.audiovisual: BGM music(0,200,7) 用 Kajam 循环占声道0-2；声道3 播自定义 SFX16 移动、SFX17 旋转，仅动作成功发声；消行 sfx0、失败 sfx4
preserve: 橙/黄/绿等16色像素块风格
unresolved: DAS 6帧/ARR 3帧与软降 2 帧的手感需掌机试玩确认
是否要加锁延迟内的旋转续期上限以外的额外容错
